audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly credits K'Sante with a 'percent-HP passive', calls Path Maker a 'block', says his knockup threat comes 'every 30 seconds', and never mentions Footwork's shield or All Out's healing.
audit.why: Riot text: Dauntless Instinct marks a target so his NEXT attack hits harder — no percent health anywhere in his kit (percentHealth is Swain's own passive flag). Ntofo Strikes is a flat 3.5s and at 2 stacks fires a shockwave that PULLS enemies in; the knockback-and-stun is Path Maker, a 14s charge-up that reduces the damage he takes and deals true damage. Footwork is a 10s dash that shields him. All Out is 120s at rank 1, knocks you through walls, heals him, and strips his own defenses.
audit.corrected: Slot roles, the 3.5s and 14s and 10s and 120s numbers, the shockwave pull, the shield and the healing all written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, phases[3].why, whys[0], whys[3], spikes[2], wants.foe[1] and wants.foe[2].

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around All Out's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His peak: Ntofo Strikes is 3.5s, and two stacks fire a shockwave that pulls you in. Farm, hold E, refuse the brawl.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. K'Sante carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: both kits plateau — the 1v1 is a coin flip, so win it in the 5v5 where your drain AOE is better.

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — His duelist mode. Drain when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - All Out: 120s at rank 1 — it strips his own resists and heals him, so hold Grievous Wounds for it. - Path Maker: 14s charge-up that reduces the damage he takes, then a stun. - Footwork: 10s dash and shield; force it out first.

edits.before: Track K'Sante's All Out: His duelist mode. Drain when it’s down. When it is down — E-root + R him.
edits.after: All Out is 120s and strips his resists — drain him inside it, but bring Grievous Wounds for the heal.

edits.before: His duelist mode. Drain when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: That is K'Sante's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Two Ntofo stacks fire a shockwave that pulls you in — break the chain, not the wave.

edits.before: K'Sante's percent-HP passive barely registers damage at level 1 and your Q has no setup — both sides farm and neither can force a decisive trade.
edits.after: Dauntless Instinct only marks you for one empowered attack at level 1, and your Q has no setup — both sides farm and neither can force a trade.

edits.before: Short Q cooldowns give him a knockup threat every 30 seconds, and his passive percent-HP damage accumulates across repeated skirmishes faster than your fragment stack builds — this is his lane peak.

edits.after: K'Sante's first Heartsteel or Unending Despair widens his Path Maker damage reduction and his healing, letting him tank your poke and reset trades.

edits.after: Charge Path Maker to cut the damage from your W poke, then dash in and stun you before E is back
